capabilities: add typed connections between notes via a command modal
display all connections in a right-sidebar pane
delete connections with a trash icon
define mapped connection types from frontmatter properties
control whether a mapped connection's subject is the source or target
extras: The README's demo section appears empty, so there are no screenshots; mapping connections relies on frontmatter properties.
problem: Obsidian links are untyped, so there is no built-in way to label what kind of relationship one note has to another or see those labels listed.

relations.evidence: This plugin plays nicely with the Folder Notes plugin.

summary: Named-connection manager that lets users define typed relationships between notes and view them in a sidebar pane.
